capabilities: Expand a trigger tag into an inline field template when followed by a space
Place the cursor in the first empty field or at a configurable offset
Configure schemas pairing trigger tags with expansion text in settings
Write [key:: value] inline fields queryable by Dataview
Avoid re-triggering expansions during undo and redo
extras: Part of a nine-item offline-only suite by the same author (including the DoomEsque theme); installable via BRAT; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author built this as part of an offline-only suite so they could use Obsidian for notes in open-book law exams with certainty that nothing makes network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to expand a typed tag into a pre-defined inline field template that is ready to fill in.

relations.evidence: It brings Logseq-style "tags as classes" to Obsidian.
Filled-in #case-law lines become case cards automatically in Pomodoro Flashcards.
Expansions use [key:: value] inline fields, which Dataview and similar plugins can query.

summary: Snippet expander that turns a trigger tag like #case-law into an inline field template as you type, with the cursor in the first field.
